# TC.PeripheralInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.PeripheralInfo"></a>

### TC.PeripheralInfo

This is detached physical metadata, not a LuaEntity or a reusable authority proof.
Positions and footprints describe the logical rectangle of a monitor.
Terminal axes and dimensions are separate.
Native carriers remain discoverable without power.

### direction

Cardinal orientation.

```text
'north'|'east'|'south'|'west'
```

### footprint

Axis-aligned world extent, not terminal dimensions.

```text
TC.Footprint
```

### label (optional)

Descriptive label, not necessarily unique. Absent when unset.

```text
string
```

### modem_tier (optional)

Present for radar modems only.

```text
'surface'|'interplanetary'
```

### name

Exact current logical/physical service identity.

```text
TC.PeripheralName
```

### position

World coordinates of the device center or logical monitor center.

```text
TC.Position
```

### powered

Live physical availability. Valid custom devices need no electricity.

```text
boolean
```

### quality

Installed prototype quality name.

```text
string
```

### surface

Current surface identity, not cross-surface access.

```text
TC.Surface
```

### type

Public facade family.

```text
TC.PeripheralType
```

### wire

Selected proven discovery channel.

```text
TC.Wire
```
